opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The total capital investment made in energy conservation equipment during the year amounts to ` 495.92 lakhs" (annual report)

opportunities.point: The company has been building production capacity to seize potential growth opportunities.

opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "M/s Manisha & Associates, Cost Accountants, Nagpur, the cost auditors appointed by the Board of Directors of the Company, to conduct the audit of the cost records of the Company for the financial year ending 31st March, 2027 be paid remuneration of Rs...." (annual report) [FY27]

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
threats.evidence: Price grew 19% vs profit 10% (5Y) — stock ahead of fundamentals; watch valuation.

threats.point: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia has negatively impacted raw material availability and pricing.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Due to the current conflict in West Asia, not only are we experiencing heightened volatility in the prices of raw materials (linked to crude), but their availability also seems to be impacted." (annual report)

threats.point: The company faced challenges from domestic disruptions in May 2025 and U.S. tariffs on its products.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "We tried to bridge the shortfall by furthering our presence in the domestic market along with the exploration of new geographies internationally. And just when we felt we had turned a corner, the situation in West Asia dampened momentum." (annual report)

threats.point: Management noted that wars spanning geographies and tariff-wars have created volatility and uncertainty in global trade.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "In 2025, not only are we plagued with wars spanning geographies but the tariff-wars have added a whole new dimension to how countries will trade with each other in the times to come." (annual report)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Sep) are still in the cycle.
